utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow. Just let me know what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know the exact spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you start with the repair drive details? Just the first item is enough, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Faye, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or swing by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — send me the details first, and I’ll see if I can fit it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What time does the repair drive start, and should I bring gloves or tape?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — can you confirm the exact start time and spot for the repair drive? I can bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, sure—I'll send the details your way. It’s been getting a nice little turnout, so there’s plenty to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess. I probably missed part of that, so send me what you’ve got when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m keeping an eye out for the exact spot and I’ll let you know as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just let me know when you’ve got it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, and we’re gathering tools plus sorting the repair list. If you’re free, I can put you where we need the most hands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll repeat that plan to everyone. Put me where you need the most hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the running list of what we need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep you posted on the start time once I know it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help—just point me to the job that needs the most hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Sam — I’m still just hearing bits second-hand, but it sounds like the repair drive is coming up soon and staying pretty low-key.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ve got a running list going. Just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching for the exact setup spot, and I’ll let you know as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the repair drive details first—what should I look at?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please check the start time and what’s been gathered so far, and let me know if I should bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll keep an eye out for where they set up the repair drive and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Jules — just send me the spot when you know it.
